name: Bashal'Aran
summary: Asterion seeks release from his prison among the ruined pillars of Bashal'Aran. He has traced the binding magic to the satyrs who command the grells and asks travelers to recover the Ancient Moonstone Seal.

sections.title: A Prison of Ancient Stone
sections.body: For more than a thousand years, Asterion has remained bound to the ruins of Bashal'Aran. The marble pillars around him mark the limits of his prison, beyond the reach of his fading strength and ancient magic. A cursed relic holds him here. Through the centuries, he has watched Darkshore's canopy and wondered whether the wearing stone could ever set him free.

sections.title: Satyrs and the Moonstone Seal
sections.body: Nearby grells carried traces of the magic that binds Asterion, and he deduced that the Ancient Moonstone Seal was the source of the enchantment. The satyrs who command the grells now hold the seal. These demonic night elves wander the ancient groves, keeping watch over the relic. Asterion needs the seal recovered before its binding power can be broken.

faq.answer: Asterion is an ancient night elf spirit trapped among the ruined pillars of Bashal'Aran. Bound by ancient magic for more than a thousand years, he cannot leave his stone prison or pass on.

faq.q: Why do the satyrs have the Ancient Moonstone Seal?
faq.answer: The satyrs influence and command the wild grells of northern Darkshore. When Asterion sensed traces of the binding magic in the grells, he deduced that the satyrs held the Ancient Moonstone Seal, the source of his captivity.

faq.q: What happens once the seal is recovered?
faq.answer: Asterion takes hold of the recovered Ancient Moonstone Seal, the relic that has bound him for centuries. Then the seal can be broken, freeing him to walk the forests again.

Bashal'Aran is an ancient night elf ruin on the misty shores of northern Darkshore. Once a magnificent settlement or holy enclave, it now lies broken, plagued by grells, satyrs, and trapped spirits from an earlier age.

faq.q: How long has Asterion been trapped here?
faq.answer: Asterion has been imprisoned for more than a thousand years. Unable to break the boundary by strength or magic, he has waited through the centuries, wondering if he will ever be free.

faq.q: Can Asterion simply walk away from the shrine?
faq.answer: No. The Ancient Moonstone Seal maintains a barrier around the shrine, and its stone pillars keep Asterion's spirit from crossing beyond them.

angles.text: Bashal'Aran recalls your people's ancient past, where lingering ancestors remain chained to the earth by satyrs who embody the demonic betrayal of the Sundering.
The satyrs' influence still corrupts Darkshore's wildlife and disturbs ancient spirits who should rest peacefully in nature's cycle.
Cleansing Darkshore's ruins of satyr corruption secures Kalimdor's northern coast and helps the Kaldorei lay their tragic past to rest.
